data.title: Ferencvaros vs Torreense - prediction, preview & betting tips - 22/10/2026
data.content:
Head coach Balazs Borbely has no new injury or suspension worries ahead of this clash, but Bence Otvos (ACL), who has been out of action since February, remains unavailable.

Kristoffer Zachariassen has been impressive so far, having contributed directly to four of the team's five goals in this competition (3 goals, 1 assist). While some rotation is expected, the 32-year-old is expected to start alongside Yusuf Bamidele, who has three goal contributions so far. [...] Luis Miguel Tralhao's men kicked off their campaign with an impressive 2-1 victory on the road against Lillestrom before their heartbreaking loss at the hands of Sunderland last Thursday.

Torreense head into this clash with a fully fit squad, bolstered by the return of Nuha Jatta from suspension. Since the Portuguese side did not play during the weekend, they are better-rested than their hosts, who have had a busy schedule. [...] ## Whispers Predicts: Ferencvaros 3-1 Torreense

Priced at 7/20 (1.35), Ferencvaros are considered favourites by the bookmakers ahead of this skirmish.

In addition to having the advantage of playing at home, the Hungarian side have been a difficult team to beat, and with Torreense coming off back-to-back losses, we are confident that Ferencvaros will earn a fairly comfortable victory here.
